proposals.before: Earlier, when Zongfang was educational commissioner in Guizhou, the governor-general proposed surveying all land in the province to increase taxation, terrifying the populace. When educational officials were ordered to collect documents, he found a memorial by Censor Bao Chengzuo. In the early Qianlong reign, Educational Commissioner Zou Yigui had requested land surveys, but Chengzuo had memorialized in rebuttal, arguing that Guizhou had more mountains than flat land, that people often falsely claimed barren plots, that clerks manipulated the process, that surveying uneven terrain would not necessarily increase revenue, and that the people would suffer.

decisions.reason: s0122 has 與巡撫籌賑務; 巡撫 is the provincial governor (xunfu), not governor-general (總督). The proposed 'governor' correctly restores the office named in the Chinese.

s0124 has 巡撫議丈全省田; the proposer of the Guizhou land survey is a 巡撫 (governor), not a 總督. Replacing governor-general with governor matches the Chinese and leaves the rest of the accurate human wording intact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 巡撫議丈全省田為增賦計

decisions.reason: s0125 has 持以示巡撫曰; Zongfang showed the memorial to the 巡撫. Governor-general would be 總督, which is absent; 'governor' is the correct title.
s0127 begins 巡撫亦悟; the official who understood and dropped the matter is again the 巡撫. The proposed 'governor' corrects the false elevation to governor-general.
s0128 has 署巡撫麟慶; Lin Qing was acting 巡撫 (acting governor), not acting governor-general. The proposed wording correctly renders 署巡撫.
s0148 has 江西巡撫裕泰; Yu Tai is identified as Jiangxi 巡撫 (provincial governor), not 總督. 'Jiangxi Governor' is the accurate title; the rest of the sentence is sound.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 南昌知府張寅為江西巡撫裕泰劾罷

decisions.reason: s0208 has 授山西巡撫; the appointment is to Shanxi 巡撫 (governor), not governor-general. The proposed 'governor of Shanxi' matches the Chinese office.

In s0081, 兵部以慶廉送武會試有殘疾，為監試御史所劾, the passive 為監試御史所劾 attaches to the Ministry of War's improper sending of the disabled candidate, not to Qing Lian as impeached person. English 'he was impeached' wrongly makes Qing Lian the target; 'the responsible officials were impeached' restores the correct patient of 劾, and s0082's contrast with Na Qingan's earlier disqualification of Qing Lian confirms that reading.
